seo.title: Psychiatry in Ladue, MO | Plan Your Recovery
seo.description: Psychiatric evaluation and medication management in Ladue, MO. In-person and telehealth with board-certified providers — our office is in the heart of Ladue.

hero.headline: Psychiatry in Ladue, Missouri
hero.intro: Our office is located right in Ladue, which means a medication evaluation doesn't require crossing the county — and for families who'd rather keep care close and private, that matters as much as the clinical side.

whyLocals.heading: Why Ladue Patients Choose Us
whyLocals.paragraph: John Gransbach, DNP sees patients in person at our Ladue office, including adolescents — his doctoral research focused on helping anxious teens manage symptoms and reduce suicidal ideation, which comes up more than families expect in high-achieving school environments. Angela Jones, PMHNP offers telehealth-first medication management for adults who'd rather handle a follow-up from home.

treatmentSection.intro: Here's what psychiatric care looks like at our Ladue office:

services.name: Psychiatric Evaluation & Medication Management
services.description: A thorough initial evaluation and ongoing management for depression, anxiety, ADHD, bipolar disorder, and other conditions — for adults and adolescents.

services.name: Buprenorphine (Suboxone) for Opioid Use Disorder
services.description: New patients are typically seen within 1–3 days.

services.name: Outpatient Alcohol Detoxification
services.description: Medically supervised outpatient detox for appropriate candidates who don't require inpatient-level care.

localFaqs.question: Can a Ladue teen get a psychiatric evaluation, not just adults?
localFaqs.answer: Yes — John Gransbach, DNP treats adolescents and has specific clinical experience with teen anxiety and mood concerns, including when they escalate further than typical stress. Evaluations run about 45–60 minutes and cover history, symptoms, and whether medication is appropriate.

localFaqs.question: Is a visit to your Ladue office confidential from the rest of the community?
localFaqs.answer: Yes. We're direct about how confidentiality works before treatment starts, and we take it seriously precisely because our office serves a community where people often know each other.

localFaqs.question: What insurance is accepted for psychiatry in Ladue?
localFaqs.answer: Angela Jones, PMHNP is in-network with UnitedHealthcare, Blue Cross Blue Shield, and Cigna. John Gransbach, DNP is out-of-network, with documentation available for reimbursement through plans that offer out-of-network mental health benefits.
